paper_metadata.title: In vivo genome editing of human haematopoietic stem cells for treatment of blood disorders using mRNA delivery

papers.access: user-provided main text PDF + Supplementary Tables 1-15 (xlsx) + full figure source data (xlsx)
extraction_log: Three ionizable lipid libraries (A: 35 lipids, alpha-acylamino acyl amide linker; B: 32, 2-(aminomethyl)propane-1,3-diol; C: 25, carbamothioic S-acid linker) screened in vivo at 2 mg/kg, two doses, BM PCSK9 editing
Leads: LNP-028 (A), LNP-217 (B), LNP-306 (C); LNP-028 markedly higher than B/C leads (Fig. 3b values figure-only)
LNP-168 (optimized from Library A): 48.5% BM PCSK9 editing vs 19.7% for LNP-028, second dose (Fig. 4a, text)
miR-122T 3'-UTR detargeting: liver editing 71.0% -> 19.0%, BM editing retained (Fig. 4d, text)

LNP-028-ABE8e-HBG humanized NCG-X (healthy donors): 11.0% A5 / 8.4% A6 single 2.0 mg/kg dose, gamma-globin 22.2%; mobilization not beneficial; repeat dosing q2w x5 increased editing (Fig. 3i,j figure-only)
LNP-168-ABE8e-HBG TDT patient HSPCs in NCG-X: 42.6% HBG promoter editing, two doses of 1.0 mg/kg; gamma-globin 0.14 -> 0.60 vs alpha-globin; restored erythroid morphology; no engraftment harm
LNP-168-Cre-miR-122T in Ai14: >80% MPP3 tdTomato+, higher than MC3 control across LSK/MPP/HSC (Fig. 4f-h)
Formulation (all LNPs): 50:38.5:10:1.5 ionizable:chol:DSPC:DMG-PEG2000, N:P 4.5, NanoAssemblr, 69-90 nm, EE >90% (Methods; per-formulation values in Supp Tables 7-9, not provided)

Safety (Fig. 6): transient ALT/AST resolved by 2 weeks; IP-10/TNF/IL-6/IL-1beta resolved within 48 h; no anti-PEG/anti-Cas9 IgG on second dose; Lipid-168 plasma t1/2 ~2.5 h; mRNA/sgRNA undetectable after 72 h
Off-target: 38 candidate sites by NGS, nearly undetectable (Extended Data Fig. 10a)
Not extracted: RNP electroporation ex vivo data (not LNP); per-lipid library values for all 92 formulations (Extended Data Figs. 3-5, image tables)
anchors.py: sgRNA-25 targets HBG1/2 promoter (GRCh38 chr11); exact sequence in Supp Table 3 (not provided), coordinate verification pending

Supp Table 9: exact size/PDI/EE/pKa for LNP-028-ABE8e-sg25 (70.6 nm, 0.01, 96.5%, pKa 7.28), LNP-168-ABE8e-sg25 (73.6, 0.04, 92.6%, 7.32), LNP-168-Cre-miR-122 (69.1, 0.02, 89.9%, 7.43), plus LNP-168-Luc variants
Supp Table 7: LNP-028/217/306 PCSK9 characterization (79.0/72.1/73.0 nm, PDI 0.02-0.03, EE 91.5-94.5%)
Supp Table 8 + Fig 4a source data: 50-formulation secondary screen of Library A; 6 top performers added as records (LNP-151/163/164/165/167/169, second-dose bars 17-27%)
sgRNA-25 = AGGCAAGGCTGGCCAACCCA (Supp Table 4); GRCh38 verified: chr11:5,249,976-5,249,995 (HBG2) and chr11:5,254,900-5,254,919 (HBG1), 4,924 bp spacing, PASS
Protein corona: Supp Tables 11-13 (LNP-168-Luc vs MC3-Luc; albumin 29.7%, fibronectin 7.9%, fibrinogen gamma 7.3% top on LNP-168)

Source-data anomalies flagged for Pass 2: Fig 4a LNP-123 single-dose replicate '116.0' (impossible >100% value); plotted bars vs replicate means mismatch for several LNPs (e.g. LNP-167 bar 27 vs mean 33.2); text 48.5% vs Fig 4a bar 46% for LNP-168
Not imported: full 92-lipid library screen values (ED Figs 3-5 source data parsed and available; import pending user decision on dataset shape)

FULL IMPORT: all 92 primary library screen formulations (A: 35, B: 32, C: 25; ED Figs 3-5 source data) and all 50 secondary-screen formulations (Fig 4a source data) imported as individual records, minus 10 already curated = 134 added
Per-record label_for_ml assigned from second-dose bar with atlas thresholds (>30 high, 10-30 medium, <10 low): 110 low, 24 medium among screen records; directly addresses gap 28 label imbalance
LNP-123 116% outlier replicate flagged in-record (null_fields.data_anomaly)

label_for_ml.primary_metric_used: base editing % at HBG promoter (A5/A6) or PCSK9 (A6) in BM cells / human HSPCs
label_for_ml._note: adds medium-class records (LNP-028 arms, MC3 control), helping label balance (gap 28)
